midConversationSystem.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages — "This feature is available on Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Sonnet 5.5. No beta header is required for mid-conversation system messages. This feature is not available on Claude Sonnet 5."

midConversationToolChanges.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages — tool_addition / tool_removal blocks in a role:"system" message, by reference ("The `mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01` header works for changes that name a tool by reference, on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud"); same model list as mid-conversation system messages, which names Claude Sonnet 5.5; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5 — Feature support lists mid-conversation tool changes (beta) on Claude Sonnet 5.5 and not on Claude Sonnet 5.

inlineToolDefinitions.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages — tool_addition with a tool_definition ("On the Claude API, send the `inline-tools-2026-09-15` beta header, which also covers defining a tool inside a `tool_addition` block"), same models as the reference changes, Claude Sonnet 5.5 included; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5 — "Define tools in a message (beta)" on Claude Sonnet 5.5. Claude API only, so set on the anthropic and console providers (both api.anthropic.com), never on a cloud reseller.
